description: Use once the user has confirmed that several accounts on different networks are one person, for instance from suggest_creator_identity's evidence. Save them as one creator identity: `name` (who they are), `accounts` (each {platform, handle, evidence?}) and an optional `note`. Stores exactly the accounts given and infers nothing: an account already in another identity is refused with that identity named, never moved. Shared by the whole workspace. Never save a suggestion nobody confirmed. No cost to call.

evidence.description: What showed these are one person, e.g. suggest_creator_identity's evidence.

name: save_creator_identity
title: Save Creator Identity
